summary: An item as a ScriptableObject asset, so adding an item is creating an asset rather than editing code.
overview: Items as assets instead of hardcoded strings or an enum: add one by creating an asset, with no code change and no recompile. It builds on GameDataAsset for the string id used to save, load and look items up — so moving Inventory into another project means taking that folder too.
useCases: Designer-authored items with no programmer in the loop.
Referencing the same item from loot tables, shops and the inventory without duplicating data.
Saving what the player owns as stable ids rather than asset paths.

gotchas.title: The id is what saves, so renaming it breaks saves
gotchas.body: Renaming the ASSET is safe. Changing the id inside it orphans every save that referenced the old one.
